verdict.rationale: Spend visibility, cost attribution and usage-spike alerting are fair questions for an observability SaaS like Sentry, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of usage or spend dashboards, per-team or per-project cost attribution, or spike-protection or quota alerts. The pricing tiers and the agent-tracing 'spend' claim (which covers LLM agent spend, not Sentry's own bill) do not address the story.
